diagnostics.message: local_file.public_ssh_key declares `depends_on = ["tls_private_key.ssh"]`, but its `content = tls_private_key.ssh.public_key_openssh` already establishes the dependency implicitly (tls_private_key.ssh appears in its implicit_deps). The explicit depends_on is redundant.

local_file.private_ssh_key declares `depends_on = ["tls_private_key.ssh"]`, but its `content = tls_private_key.ssh.private_key_pem` already establishes the dependency implicitly (tls_private_key.ssh appears in its implicit_deps). The explicit depends_on is redundant.
